description: Wolfee records, transcribes, and analyzes your meetings, then makes that intelligence available to your AI assistant. Connect Wolfee to ask natural-language questions about any meeting: pull a full transcript, surface action items and commitments, search your entire meeting history by meaning (not just keywords), review video recordings, and see which upcoming calendar meetings Wolfee will record next. All access is read-only and scoped to your own data.
